components.description: Leave donated by colleagues to a bank may be granted, at the chancellor's decision, to a regular full-time employee with two years of State service who has exhausted all leave, for a catastrophic medical condition of the employee or a family member, for up to six continuous months.

components.eligible_parent_wording: their own or a family member's medical emergencies; Family Member means spouse, dependent child ... or parent

mechanism: Catastrophic Leave Bank means a pool of accrued annual and/or sick leave voluntarily donated by employees of the university in accordance with rules and regulations established in Act 169 of 1991 for use by other employees.
faculty_group: Only current, regular, full-time employees of the University of Arkansas at Little Rock shall be eligible to participate in the Catastrophic Leave Bank Program.
eligible_parent: Family Member means spouse, dependent child (as recognized by the State of Arkansas Individual Income Tax Division), or parent of the employee.
entitlement: Submission of a completed application for catastrophic leave does not guarantee that leave will be granted.

notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are saved: UA Board Policy 420.1 (2018_04) and its campus copy UALR 402.34 (2018_01), restated in the 2000 Faculty Handbook ch. 7 (2018_09); UA Board Policy 405.1 (2018_03) and UALR 403.15 (2018_02) for the tenure clock; UALR 401.4 (2018_06) for FMLA; UALR 402.5 (2018_08) for the catastrophic leave bank. So The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply and missing is false.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave and no modified duties appear in any saved document. The only birth-specific provision is the pregnancy leave of absence without pay (c1), with no length stated; pay during a birth can come only from the employee's own sick leave (c2), or for twelve-month appointees annual leave (c4), and after exhaustion from the colleague-funded catastrophic leave bank (c9, discretionary; routine disabilities excluded).

2018_00 (HR FMLA page) is a summary for employees generally; 2018_06 (Policy 401.4) is the governing FMLA policy. The HR page adds that UALR requires employees to use available accrued paid leave concurrently with FMLA; recorded in c6 runs_concurrently_with, not as a separate component.

2018_07 (Policy 403.5, Faculty Absence from Work) holds only notification rules; no component. 2018_10 is the handbook's table of contents (navigation and version evidence: the Provost's page captured 2018-03-14 lists the 2000 handbook as 'the most up-to-date version'); no policy text.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or not parental): military leave, court and jury leave, vacation leave for graduate study (accumulation rule), Off-Campus Duty Assignment (a project-based sabbatical), attendance at professional meetings, the standard work load's teaching reductions 'through reassignment or through use of banked IUs' (a mission workload tool; the Faculty Instructional Load Policy is cited but not saved), political-activity leave.

Tenure clock (c8): Board Policy 405.1 (rev. 2001) excludes a year with more than one-half spent on leave without pay; the older campus copy 403.14 (effective 1994, capture 2019) says any time on leave without pay does not count. 403.15 (2009) restates the Board Policy wording, so the Board Policy is coded; flagged conflicting_sources for transparency.

Calendar: the handbook states a semester system ('twelve instructional units (IUs) per semester'; year = fall and spring semesters) without a length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in semesters.

Cross-references cited but not saved: procedures approved by the president for probationary-period suspension (BP 405.1 IV.A.4); Act 169 of 1991 and Department of Finance and Administration catastrophic-leave rules; long-term disability plan details (Office of Human Resource Services); UALR Faculty Instructional Load Policy; Handbook for Part-Time Faculty; Staff Handbook; Board Policy 420.5 (worker's compensation); AHRMS Policy Manual Sec. 105-3 and 29 CFR 825 (cited as sources of 401.4); FMLA forms (FMLA at a Glance, Request Packet, Employee Rights Under the FMLA); Board Policies 405.2, 405.3, 410.1, 415.1, 440.1, 450.1, 465.1, 475.1, 705.1, 210.1, 220.1, 240.1 and Administrative Memoranda (unrelated topics).

Birth parent chain: pregnancy leave without pay (c1, length not stated) with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (c6 concurrent_with c1); own sick leave (c2) and catastrophic leave (c9) are pay from own or donated balances, unlinked and counted in no paid figure. Expected: 0 paid weeks under the 2018 definition; protected 12 (FMLA).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c6) alone; sick leave for a seriously ill spouse (c3, discretionary, own balance) and catastrophic leave for a family member (c9) are pay only. Tenure-clock suspension (c7, discretionary, 1 year) for either parent.
Reference date 2018-03-13. Board Policy 405.1 was revised 2018-03-29, after the reference date; the saved 2001 revision is the one in force.
